programme.title: The Incredible Dr. Pol

programme.title: The Incredible Dr. Pol
programme.desc: What's Moo with Ewe: There's a full week of emergencies, reunions and ruffling feathers, as cat fights cause havoc and an emu finds itself in need of a rescue. (S7, ep 12)

programme.title: Ocean Fight Club

programme.title: Dolphins Up Close: Bertie Gregory
programme.desc: Bertie aims to film thousands of migrating predators as they unite for one of the ocean's most spectacular feeding events off the coast of Portugal. 7+

programme.title: Ice Road Rescue
programme.desc: Extreme Rescues: The towers gather to take a look back on the season. Plus, a video of a tragic rescue attempt makes them think twice about their careers. 7+ (S1, ep 10)

programme.title: Ice Road Rescue
programme.desc: Danger on Death Hill: Bjørn is called to rescue an inexperienced foreign driver who is blocking the main road on the mountain overpass, making the locals angry. 7+ (S2, ep 1)

programme.title: Ice Road Rescue
programme.desc: Big Freeze: Thord and his rookie rescue worker Andrzej have their work cut out for them when they help a polish driver with valuable cargo loaded with sugar. (S2, ep 2) 7+

programme.title: Killer Whale Chronicles
programme.desc: School of Killers: Marine biologist Florian Graner unveils orca cultures in the Salish Sea, inviting viewers to explore their fascinating mysteries. 7+ (S1, ep 2)

programme.title: Deadly Dozen: North America
programme.desc: Journey into forests, lakes and rivers to investigate North America's deadly dozen. Black widow spiders, rattlesnakes, alligators and killer bees are just a few of the dangerous critters.

programme.title: Deadly Dozen: Australia
programme.desc: Australia: Journey from the Great Barrier Reef to the Outback to see in stunning detail why Australia's deadly dozen are considered some of the most dangerous creatures in the world. 7+

programme.title: Kingdom Of The White Wolf

programme.title: Kingdom Of The White Wolf

programme.title: Kingdom Of The White Wolf
programme.desc: The Last Hunt: Having embedded himself with a family of wolves, Ronan Donovan witnesses a brutal bid for pack power after mother White Scarf strangely vanishes. (3 of 3) 7+

programme.title: Shark Attack Files
programme.desc: Man Vs Shark: Explore the most astounding shark attacks from the last several years - and how each victim fought back. 16+ (S1, ep 4)

programme.title: Africa's Deadliest

programme.desc: River Rivals: The rivers of Africa - long held in myth and legend for the life they bring and the monsters they hide. 7+ (2 of 3)

programme.title: Yukon Vet

programme.title: Heartland Docs
programme.desc: A Moo York State of Mind: The Schroeders take a road trip to New York to visit Dr Erin's parents, surprising her dad with a 1910 Cadillac. (S4, ep 4) 7+

programme.title: The Incredible Dr. Pol

programme.title: The Incredible Dr. Pol
programme.desc: Pup-Pup-Hooray!: From poorly puppies to nasty dogfights, the canines visiting PVS are having a rough day - expect everything from strict quarantines to a complicated hip surgery. (S6, ep 3)
